gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (printed p23): Proceeds from issuance of bonds 5,726,322, Debt Service Fund column only (Increase in obligations under capital lease '-'). That line is NOT added here because the first pass (schedule_fix/Blair_FY2022.json, governmental revenue entry) already adds 'Proceeds from issuance of bonds' 5,726,322 (Debt Service Fund, other financing, p5); adding it again would double it. Current schedule 1,591,215 = Street Fund budgetary schedule 'Warrant income' 1,581,498 (p13, printed among budget-basis revenues, category Debt Proceeds; the GAAP Street column on p5 prints no warrant row - budgetary basis) + Street 'Insurance proceeds' 9,717 (p14; also printed p5 as Insurance proceeds, other financing; insurance money, not debt, counted only because the label contains 'proceeds'). After the first-pass line: 1,591,215 + 5,726,322 = 7,317,537 vs statement 5,726,322; the remaining -1,591,215 = 1,581,498 (budgetary warrant income) + 9,717 (insurance proceeds), both printed lines that belong where they are. No further fix.

Proprietary statement p7, OPERATING TRANSFERS: Water Operating transfers - in 956,023, Operating transfers - out (350,000); Sewer Operating transfers - in 1,238,437. 956,023 - 350,000 + 1,238,437 = 1,844,460 = business_type.transfers_net 1,844,460 (printed Total operating transfers): exact.
